# Polymarket Documentation

- [API Reference (196 pages)](https://docs.polymarket.com/_llms/en/api-reference.md): Documentation for API Reference.

## Predictions

### Getting Started

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/index.md): Build on the world's largest prediction market. Trade, integrate, and access real-time market data with the Polymarket API.
- [Polymarket 101](https://docs.polymarket.com/polymarket-101.md): An intro to Polymarket - the world's largest prediction market

#### SDKs & APIs

- [SDKs & APIs](https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/sdks-apis.md): Choose how to integrate with Polymarket.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/typescript.md): Get started with the unified Polymarket TypeScript SDK.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/python.md): Get started with the unified Polymarket Python SDK.
- [API](https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/api.md): Build directly with Polymarket REST APIs and WebSocket streams.
- [SDK Migration](https://docs.polymarket.com/getting-started/migrate-from-previous-sdks.md): Move an existing Polymarket integration to the unified SDKs.

### Core Concepts

- [Markets & Events](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/markets-events.md): Understanding the fundamental building blocks of Polymarket
- [Negative Risk Markets](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/negative-risk.md): Capital-efficient trading for multi-outcome events
- [Prices & Orderbook](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/prices-orderbook.md): How prices work and how the order book enables peer-to-peer trading
- [Positions & Tokens](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/positions-tokens.md): Understanding outcome tokens and how positions work on Polymarket
- [Polymarket USD](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/pusd.md): pUSD — the collateral token used for all trading on Polymarket
- [Order Lifecycle](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/order-lifecycle.md): Understanding how orders flow from creation to settlement
- [Resolution](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/resolution.md): How markets are resolved and winning positions redeemed

### Market Data

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/overview.md): Learn how Polymarket organizes market data and where to begin.
- [Discover Markets](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/discover-markets.md): Learn how to find and filter events and markets and explore related metadata.
- [Market Details](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/market-details.md): Understand the structure and state of a Polymarket market.
- [Prices and Order Books](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/prices-order-books.md): Learn how prices and order books represent trading activity on Polymarket.
- [Analytics](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/public-analytics.md): Understand activity and performance across Polymarket.
- [Real-Time Data](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/realtime-data.md): Keep market data current with Polymarket's real-time feeds.
- [Chainlink TWAP Prices](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-data/chainlink-twap.md): Consume Chainlink-computed TWAP prices directly or through Polymarket RTDS.

### Trading

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/overview.md): Understand how orders, settlement, and positions fit together on Polymarket.
- [Place Your First Order](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/quickstart.md): Learn how to authenticate with the CLOB and submit your first market order.
- [Wallets and Authentication](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/wallets-auth.md): Connect or create a Polymarket account for trading.
- [Session Keys](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/session-keys.md): Authorize a separate signer for scoped, time-limited Deposit Wallet trading.
- [Place Orders](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/place-orders.md): Learn how to place orders and control how they execute
- [Manage Orders](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/manage-orders.md): Learn how to track and manage orders after submitting them.
- [Real-Time Order Updates](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/realtime-order-updates.md): React to authenticated order and trade activity as it happens.
- [Wallet Activity](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/wallet-activity.md): Track the positions and activity associated with a Polymarket wallet.
- [Fees](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees.md): Understanding trading fees on Polymarket
- [Market Making](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/market-making.md): Guidance for operating a market-making system on Polymarket.
- [Matching Engine Restarts](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/matching-engine.md): Maintenance windows, restart handling, and post-restart post-only mode

#### Positions

- [How Positions Work](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/positions/how-positions-work.md): Understand the onchain token mechanics that power Polymarket positions.
- [Manage Positions](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/positions/manage.md): Learn how to manage outcome-token inventory from creation through redemption.
- [Combinatorial Positions](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/positions/combinatorial.md): Multi-leg positions built from existing Polymarket outcomes

#### Combos

- [How Combos Work](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/combos/overview.md): Understand Combo positions and the RFQ flow for multi-leg markets
- [Market Makers](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/combos/market-makers.md): Build a market maker integration for pricing and executing Combos
- [Combos for Builders](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/combos/builders.md): Request and execute Combo quotes for users through the Builder Gateway
- [Collateral Return](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/combos/collateral-return.md): Release pUSD from compatible Combo positions before resolution

#### Bridge

- [Deposit](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/deposit.md): Bridge assets from any supported chain to fund your Polymarket account
- [Supported Assets](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/supported-assets.md): Chains and tokens supported for deposits to Polymarket
- [Quote](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/quote.md): Preview fees and estimated output for deposits and withdrawals
- [Withdraw](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/withdraw.md): Bridge pUSD from Polymarket to any supported chain
- [Transaction Status](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/status.md): Track bridge deposits and withdrawals through completion

### Programs

- [Taker Rebate Program](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/taker-rebates.md): Climb the tiers and earn daily pUSD rebates as you trade
- [Maker Rebates Program](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/maker-rebates.md): Earn daily pUSD rebates by providing liquidity on Polymarket
- [Liquidity Rewards](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/liquidity-rewards.md): Earn rewards for providing liquidity on Polymarket
- [Referral Program](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/referral-program.md): Refer traders to Polymarket and earn daily pUSD rewards

#### Builder Program

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/builders/overview.md): Build applications that route orders through Polymarket
- [Builder Fees](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/builders/fees.md): How builders earn fees on orders routed through their applications, and how to integrate.
- [Tiers](https://docs.polymarket.com/programs/builders/tiers.md): Rate limits, rewards, and how to upgrade

### Resources

- [Contracts](https://docs.polymarket.com/resources/contracts.md): All Polymarket smart contract addresses, audits, and security resources
- [Data Resources](https://docs.polymarket.com/resources/blockchain-data.md): Access Polymarket on-chain activity for data & analytics
- [Error Codes](https://docs.polymarket.com/resources/error-codes.md): Complete reference for CLOB API error responses

## Perps

### Getting Started

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/overview.md): Start here for Polymarket perpetual markets
- [Concepts](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/concepts.md): Core concepts for Polymarket perpetual markets

### Build With Perps

- [Place Your First Trade](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/place-your-first-trade.md): Learn how to prepare a Perps account and submit a first buy order
- [Market Data](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/market-data.md): Discover Perps markets and monitor public market activity
- [Fund Your Account](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/fund-your-account.md): Deposit and withdraw pUSD collateral for Perps trading
- [Authenticated Sessions](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/authenticated-sessions.md): Set up authenticated access for Perps trading and account data
- [Trading](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/trading.md): Place, manage, and reconcile Perps orders
- [Account Management](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/account-management.md): Monitor balances, positions, and account history
- [Realtime Updates](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/realtime-updates.md): Stream public Perps market data
- [Notifications](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/notifications.md): Show Perps account activity as an in-app notification feed

### Learn About Trading

- [Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/overview.md): The market mechanics behind Perps trading
- [Architecture](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/architecture.md): High-level architecture of the Polymarket Perps exchange
- [Markets](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/markets.md): Listed perpetual markets and trading parameters
- [Fees](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/fees.md): Tiered maker and taker trading fees for Polymarket Perps
- [Margin](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/margin.md): Initial margin, maintenance margin, and equity calculations
- [Liquidation Mechanics](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/liquidation-mechanics.md): Detection, execution, insurance-fund backstop, and auto-deleveraging
- [Funding](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/funding.md): Funding rate calculation and settlement
- [Mark Price](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/mark-price.md): How the Mark Price is computed for Perps
- [Index Price](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/index-price.md): How the Index Price is computed for Perps
- [Market Sessions](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/learn-about-trading/market-sessions.md): How session state affects pricing feed selection

### Resources

- [Errors](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/errors.md): Error messages returned by the API and the conditions that trigger them
- [Referral Program](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/referral-program.md): Earn a share of Perps trading fees from traders you refer
- [FAQ](https://docs.polymarket.com/perps/faq.md): Common questions about Polymarket Perps trading, pricing, margin, liquidation, fees, and integration
